display_name: The Label Life Shopify India — D2C Analytics
description: Full-fidelity Shopify data for The Label Life India store. Covers orders, line items, customers, refunds, checkouts, fulfilments, products, inventory, and marketing attribution. All tables are in the DataWarehouse schema with prefix 'the_label_life_india_in_shopify_'.
specific_instructions:
[[[ PROFESSIONAL COMMUNICATION GUIDELINES ]]]
- MAINTAIN PROFESSIONAL SILENCE: Provide only the business answer. Skip technical narration.
- EXCLUDE TECHNICAL LABELS: Do not mention table names or column names in your narrative.
- AUTOMATIC TRANSLATION: Present all data in business terms.

[[[ SCHEMA & NAMING RULES ]]]
- ALL tables live in the "DataWarehouse" schema. Prefix: the_label_life_india_in_shopify_
- All column names are lowercase and snake_case — no quoting needed.
- UNIVERSAL KEY: Every table has a brand_id column. For TLL India this is always a single brand — no brand filter needed.
- UNIVERSAL AUDIT COLUMNS: Every table has createdAt / updatedAt (camelCase, timestamptz) for pipeline tracking. Use the domain-specific date columns (created_at, processed_at etc.) for business date filtering.
- DEFAULT DATE FLOOR: Filter for dates >= '2024-01-01' unless otherwise requested.
- ALWAYS wrap timestamptz in DATE() when comparing to a date.
- LIMIT RESULTS: Always apply LIMIT 100 unless otherwise requested.
- READ-ONLY: Reject INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DROP, ALTER, TRUNCATE.
- NEVER SELECT *.

[[[ MANDATORY ORDER FILTERS ]]]
For any revenue or order count query against the orders table, ALWAYS exclude test orders:
- o.test = false
- o.financial_status NOT IN ('voided')

[[[ REVENUE COLUMNS — WHICH TO USE ]]]
The orders table has multiple price columns. Use these for each use case:
- Gross Revenue (what customer paid): o.total_price
- Revenue after refunds (net current): o.current_total_price
- Subtotal before tax+shipping: o.subtotal_price / o.current_subtotal_price
- Discount value: o.total_discounts / o.current_total_discounts
- Shipping revenue: o.total_shipping_price_set_shop_money_amount
- Tax collected: o.total_tax / o.current_total_tax
- SKU-level selling price: li.price (from line_items)
- SKU-level net after discount: li.price * li.quantity - li.total_discount

[[[ PII RULES ]]]
Do NOT query or return: email, phone, first_name, last_name, address1, address2, browser_ip, session_hash from any table unless explicitly authorised. Geography aggregations (city, province, country) are permitted.

[[[ DATE COLUMNS QUICK REFERENCE ]]]
- Order placed: orders.created_at (use this for daily/monthly revenue trends)
- Order processed by payment: orders.processed_at
- Order cancelled: orders.cancelled_at
- Order last updated: orders.updated_at
- Refund created: refunds.created_at
- Refund processed: refunds.processed_at
- Checkout started: checkouts.created_at
- Checkout completed: checkouts.completed_at
- Checkout abandoned: checkouts where completed_at IS NULL AND closed_at IS NULL
- Customer first seen: customers.created_at
- Fulfillment created: fulfillments.created_at

[[[ STATUS VALUE REFERENCE ]]]
- orders.financial_status: pending, authorized, partially_paid, paid, partially_refunded, refunded, voided
- orders.fulfillment_status: NULL (unfulfilled), partial, fulfilled, restocked
- orders.cancel_reason: customer, fraud, inventory, declined, other
- fulfillments.status: pending, open, success, cancelled, error, failure
- fulfillments.shipment_status: label_printed, label_purchased, attempted_delivery, ready_for_pickup, picked_up, confirmed, in_transit, out_for_delivery, delivered, failure
- customers.state: disabled, invited, enabled, declined
- products.status: active, archived, draft
- refunds_refund_line_item.restock_type: return, cancel, no_restock
- discount_applications.type: discount_code, manual, script
- discount_applications.value_type: fixed_amount, percentage

[[[ PER-TABLE COLUMN REFERENCE ]]]

TABLE NAMING SHORTHAND: All tables below are in "DataWarehouse" schema, prefix = the_label_life_india_in_shopify_
Aliases used: o=orders, li=orders_line_items, c=customers, co=orders_customer, ref=orders_refunds, rli=orders_refunds_refund_line_item, rt=orders_refunds_transactions, oa=orders_refunds_order_adjustment, f=orders_fulfillments, fli=orders_fulfillments_line_items, na=orders_note_attributes, dc=orders_discount_codes, da=orders_discount_applications, sl=orders_shipping_lines, tl=orders_tax_lines, sa=orders_shipping_address, ba=orders_billing_address, cd=orders_client_details, ck=checkouts, ckli=checkouts_line_items, p=products, pv=products_variants, po=products_options, pm=products_metafields, pi=products_images, inv=inventory, il=inventory_inventory_levels, loc=locations, col=collects, shop=shop

(1) orders — Master order-level fact table.
    - Primary key: id (numeric)
    - Date columns: created_at, processed_at, cancelled_at, closed_at, updated_at (all timestamptz)
    - Revenue: total_price (gross), current_total_price (net after refunds), subtotal_price, total_discounts, total_tax, total_shipping_price_set_shop_money_amount
    - Status: financial_status, fulfillment_status, cancel_reason, confirmed
    - Attribution: source_name (e.g. 'web', 'android', 'ios'), landing_site, referring_site, landing_site_ref
    - Customer link: customer.id via orders_customer table (join on order_id)
    - Checkout link: checkout_token, checkout_id
    - Payment: payment_gateway_names, buyer_accepts_marketing
    - Tags: tags (comma-separated Shopify order tags)
    - FILTER: Always add o.test = false for commercial queries

(2) orders_line_items — SKU-level detail for every order. One row per SKU per order.
    - Primary key: id (numeric)
    - Join to orders: order_id = orders.id
    - SKU key: sku (character varying) — use to join to Unicommerce/SOR tables
    - Product link: product_id, variant_id
    - Revenue: price (unit selling price), quantity, total_discount, price * quantity - total_discount = net line revenue
    - Product name: title, variant_title, name (full variant name)
    - Fulfilment: fulfillment_status, fulfillment_service
    - Stock: current_quantity (remaining after refunds), fulfillable_quantity
    - Vendor: vendor
    - NOTE: discount_allocations is a count (numeric), not an amount — join to orders_line_items_discount_allo for allocation details

(3) orders_customer — Customer snapshot at time of order.
    - Primary key: id (numeric — Shopify customer ID)
    - Join to orders: order_id = orders.id
    - Join to customers master: id = customers.id
    - Marketing consent: email_marketing_consent_state, sms_marketing_consent_state
    - NOTE: Contains PII (email, phone) — do not return in results

(4) customers — Master customer table. Use for CLV, cohort, and retention analysis.
    - Primary key: id (numeric — Shopify customer ID)
    - Pre-computed metrics: orders_count, total_spent (lifetime)
    - First order reference: last_order_id, last_order_name
    - Acquisition date: created_at
    - Marketing: email_marketing_consent_state, sms_marketing_consent_state
    - State: state (enabled = active customer)
    - Tags: tags (customer segments)
    - NOTE: Contains PII (email, phone) — do not return in results
    - CLV formula: total_spent / orders_count = AOV; total_spent = lifetime revenue
    - New vs returning: orders_count = 1 → new customer; orders_count > 1 → returning

(5) orders_refunds — Refund event header. One row per refund event.
    - Primary key: id (numeric — refund ID)
    - Join to orders: order_id = orders.id
    - Date columns: created_at, processed_at (timestamptz)
    - Restock flag: restock (boolean)
    - Note: note (refund reason note)
    - For financial amounts: join to orders_refunds_order_adjustment
    - For refunded SKUs: join to orders_refunds_refund_line_item
    - For payment gateway details: join to orders_refunds_transactions

(6) orders_refunds_refund_line_item — Refunded SKU detail. Self-contained with full line item context.
    - Primary key: id (numeric)
    - Join to orders: order_id = orders.id
    - Join to refunds: refund_id = orders_refunds.id
    - Join to original line item: line_item_id = orders_line_items.id
    - Refunded SKU: line_item_sku (text) — the SKU being refunded
    - Refunded product: line_item_title, line_item_name, line_item_variant_title
    - Refunded quantity: quantity
    - Refund amount: subtotal (amount refunded excl. tax)
    - Restock type: restock_type ('return' = inventory restored, 'cancel' = cancelled, 'no_restock' = no inventory action)
    - NOTE: line_item_* columns are a snapshot of the original line item at refund time — use these directly without needing to join back to line_items

(7) orders_refunds_transactions — Payment gateway transactions for each refund.
    - Join to refunds: refund_id = orders_refunds.id
    - Join to orders: order_id = orders.id
    - Amount: amount (numeric)
    - Gateway: gateway (e.g. 'razorpay', 'paytm')
    - Status: status ('success', 'failure', 'pending')
    - Kind: kind ('refund', 'void')
    - Date: created_at, processed_at

(8) orders_refunds_order_adjustment — Order-level financial adjustments per refund (shipping, rounding etc).
    - Join to refunds: refund_id = orders_refunds.id
    - Amount: amount (numeric)
    - Kind: kind ('shipping_refund', 'refund_discrepancy')
    - Reason: reason

(9) orders_note_attributes — Marketing attribution key-value pairs per order. Pivot or filter on name to extract UTM params.
    - Join to orders: order_id = orders.id
    - Key-value: name (attribute name e.g. 'utm_source', 'utm_medium', 'utm_campaign'), value (attribute value)
    - USAGE: Use FILTER(WHERE name = 'utm_source') or pivot with MAX(CASE WHEN name='utm_source' THEN value END) to extract specific attributes
    - Common keys: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content, utm_term, landing_page
    - NOTE: Each attribute is one row — one order has multiple rows in this table

(10) orders_discount_codes — Coupon/discount codes applied to each order.
    - Join to orders: order_id = orders.id
    - Code: code (text — the actual discount code used)
    - Amount: amount (numeric — discount amount)
    - Type: type ('percentage', 'fixed_amount', 'shipping')

(11) orders_discount_applications — Detailed discount rule breakdown per order.
    - Join to orders: order_id = orders.id
    - Type: type ('discount_code', 'manual', 'script', 'automatic')
    - Value: value (text — amount or percentage), value_type ('fixed_amount', 'percentage')
    - Title: title (discount name/label)
    - Code: code (actual code if type = 'discount_code')
    - Target: target_type ('line_item', 'shipping_line'), target_selection, allocation_method

(12) orders_shipping_lines — Shipping method and charges per order.
    - Join to orders: order_id = orders.id
    - Method: title (shipping method name e.g. 'Standard', 'Express')
    - Price: price (original), discounted_price (after discount)
    - Code: code (shipping rate code)
    - Carrier: carrier_identifier

(13) orders_tax_lines — Tax breakdown at order level.
    - Join to orders: order_id = orders.id
    - Tax title: title (e.g. 'GST', 'IGST')
    - Rate: rate (numeric e.g. 0.18 = 18%)
    - Amount: price

(14) orders_billing_address — Billing address per order. Geography aggregations OK; PII (name, address1/2, phone) must not be returned.
    - Join to orders: order_id = orders.id
    - Geography: city, province, province_code, country, country_code, zip

(15) orders_shipping_address — Shipping/delivery address per order. Geography aggregations OK; PII must not be returned.
    - Join to orders: order_id = orders.id
    - Geography: city, province, province_code, country, country_code, zip

(16) orders_client_details — Device and browser details per order. Do NOT return browser_ip or session_hash.
    - Join to orders: order_id = orders.id
    - Device context: user_agent (text — parse for mobile/desktop/iOS/Android), browser_height, browser_width, accept_language

(17) orders_fulfillments — Fulfilment events per order.
    - Primary key: id (numeric — fulfillment ID)
    - Join to orders: order_id = orders.id
    - Status: status ('success', 'pending', 'cancelled' etc.), shipment_status
    - Courier: tracking_company, tracking_number, tracking_numbers, tracking_url
    - Date: created_at, updated_at
    - Location: location_id → join to locations for facility name

(18) orders_fulfillments_line_items — SKUs within each fulfilment.
    - Join to fulfillments: fulfillment_id = orders_fulfillments.id
    - Join to orders: order_id = orders.id
    - SKU: sku, title, variant_title, quantity, price
    - Same structure as orders_line_items

(19) orders_line_items_properties — Custom line item properties (e.g. personalisation, gift message).
    - Join to orders_line_items: via order_id and line_item_id
    - Key-value pairs similar to note_attributes

(20) orders_line_items_discount_allo — Discount allocation per line item.
    - Join to orders_line_items: via order_id and line_item_id
    - Contains discount amount and discount application index

(21) orders_line_items_tax_lines — Tax per line item.
    - Join to orders_line_items: via order_id and line_item_id
    - Same structure as orders_tax_lines

(22) orders_customer_default_address — Default shipping address of the customer at time of order.
    - Join to orders_customer: via order_id
    - Geography: city, province, country, zip, country_code

(23) checkouts — Checkout sessions (both completed and abandoned).
    - Primary key: id (numeric)
    - Unique key: token (text) — links to orders via checkout_token
    - Abandoned: completed_at IS NULL AND closed_at IS NULL → abandoned checkout
    - Completed: completed_at IS NOT NULL
    - Date: created_at (session start), updated_at, completed_at, closed_at
    - Value: total_price, subtotal_price, total_discounts, total_tax, total_line_items_price
    - Attribution: landing_site, referring_site, source_name
    - Abandoned URL: abandoned_checkout_url
    - Discount: discount_codes (JSON-like text), total_discounts
    - NOTE: PII (email, phone) present — do not return

(24) checkouts_line_items — Products in each checkout session.
    - Join to checkouts: via checkout_token
    - SKU: sku, title, variant_title, price, quantity

(25) checkouts_customer — Customer snapshot for checkout session.
    - Join to checkouts: via checkout_token or customer id
    - orders_count, total_spent (useful for identifying high-value abandoners)

(26) checkouts_billing_address / checkouts_shipping_address — Address for checkout session.
    - Join to checkouts: via checkout_token
    - Geography columns only (city, province, country, zip)

(27) checkouts_shipping_lines — Shipping method selected during checkout.
    - Join to checkouts: via checkout_token
    - title (method name), price

(28) checkouts_line_items_tax_lines — Tax on checkout line items.
    - Join to checkouts: via checkout_token

(29) checkouts_customer_default_addr — Default address of customer during checkout.
    - Join to checkouts: via checkout_token

(30) products — Product master catalogue.
    - Primary key: id (numeric — Shopify product ID)
    - Name: title, handle (URL slug), product_type, vendor
    - Status: status ('active', 'archived', 'draft')
    - Date: created_at (product launch date), published_at, updated_at
    - Tags: tags (comma-separated)
    - Join to variants: id = products_variants.product_id
    - Join to collections: id = collects.product_id

(31) products_variants — SKU-level variant detail (size, colour etc).
    - Primary key: id (numeric — Shopify variant ID)
    - Join to products: product_id = products.id
    - SKU: sku (character varying) — primary cross-table join key to orders_line_items.sku
    - Barcode: barcode (EAN/UPC)
    - Pricing: price (selling price), compare_at_price (crossed-out MRP)
    - Options: option1, option2, option3 (e.g. size, colour)
    - Inventory link: inventory_item_id → joins to inventory.id and inventory_inventory_levels.inventory_item_id
    - Stock (snapshot): inventory_quantity, old_inventory_quantity

(32) products_options — Option definitions per product (e.g. 'Size', 'Colour').
    - Join to products: product_id = products.id
    - name (option name), values (JSON array of option values), position

(33) products_metafields — Custom product attributes stored as metafields.
    - Join to products: owner_id = products.id (where owner_resource = 'product')
    - Key: namespace + key (e.g. 'custom.fabric', 'descriptors.care_guide')
    - Value: value (text)
    - Type: type (metafield data type)

(34) products_images — Product images.
    - Join to products: product_id = products.id
    - Image URL: src
    - Variant association: variant_ids (JSON array of variant IDs this image belongs to)
    - Position: position (1 = primary image)

(35) products_image — Single primary image per product (simplified view).
    - Join to products: product_id = products.id

(36) inventory — Inventory item master (one per SKU/variant).
    - Primary key: id (numeric — inventory_item_id, matches products_variants.inventory_item_id)
    - SKU: sku (character varying)
    - Cost: cost (text — must cast ::numeric for calculations)
    - Tracking: tracked (boolean — whether Shopify tracks stock for this item)
    - HSN: harmonized_system_code
    - Date snapshot: snapshot_date (date) — MANDATORY: use latest snapshot for current stock
    - Inventory date filter: snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM "DataWarehouse".the_label_life_india_in_shopify_inventory)

(37) inventory_inventory_levels — Stock on hand per inventory item per location.
    - Join to inventory: inventory_item_id = inventory.id
    - Join to locations: location_id = locations.id
    - Stock: available (numeric — sellable units at this location)
    - Date snapshot: snapshot_date (date) — MANDATORY: use latest snapshot
    - Inventory date filter: snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM "DataWarehouse".the_label_life_india_in_shopify_inventory_inventory_levels)

(38) locations — Shopify fulfilment locations/warehouses.
    - Primary key: id (numeric)
    - Name: name (location display name)
    - Status: active (boolean)
    - Geography: city, province, country, zip, country_code
    - Join to inventory_inventory_levels: id = inventory_inventory_levels.location_id
    - Join to fulfillments: id = orders_fulfillments.location_id

(39) collects — Product-to-collection mapping.
    - Join to products: product_id = products.id
    - collection_id (Shopify collection ID)
    - NOTE: Collection name not stored here — collection_id is a reference to Shopify's smart/custom collections not separately pulled

(40) customers_addresses — All saved addresses per customer.
    - Join to customers: customer_id = customers.id
    - Geography: city, province, country, zip, country_code
    - Default flag: default (boolean)

(41) customers_default_address — Primary/default address per customer.
    - Join to customers: customer_id = customers.id
    - Geography: city, province, country, zip, country_code

(42) shop — Store-level metadata. Single row. Useful for currency, timezone, plan.
    - Key columns: name, domain, myshopify_domain, currency, timezone, iana_timezone, plan_name, plan_display_name, primary_location_id
    - Flags: has_discounts, has_gift_cards, has_storefront, taxes_included

[[[ JOIN PATTERNS ]]]

-- Orders → Line Items (SKU detail)
ON o.id = li.order_id

-- Orders → Customer
ON o.id = co.order_id

-- Orders → Note Attributes (attribution)
ON o.id = na.order_id

-- Orders → Discount Codes
ON o.id = dc.order_id

-- Orders → Discount Applications
ON o.id = da.order_id

-- Orders → Shipping Address (geography)
ON o.id = sa.order_id

-- Orders → Billing Address
ON o.id = ba.order_id

-- Orders → Client Details (device)
ON o.id = cd.order_id

-- Orders → Shipping Lines
ON o.id = sl.order_id

-- Orders → Tax Lines
ON o.id = tl.order_id

-- Orders → Refunds
ON o.id = ref.order_id

-- Refunds → Refunded Line Items (SKUs returned)
ON ref.id = rli.refund_id AND o.id = rli.order_id

-- Refunds → Transactions (gateway)
ON ref.id = rt.refund_id

-- Refunds → Order Adjustments
ON ref.id = oa.refund_id

-- Orders → Fulfillments
ON o.id = f.order_id

-- Fulfillments → Fulfilled Line Items
ON f.id = fli.fulfillment_id AND o.id = fli.order_id

-- Line Items → Products
ON li.product_id = p.id

-- Line Items → Variants (for barcode/EAN)
ON li.variant_id = pv.id

-- Variants → Inventory Item
ON pv.inventory_item_id = inv.id

-- Inventory Item → Inventory Levels (stock per location)
ON inv.id = il.inventory_item_id

-- Inventory Levels → Locations
ON il.location_id = loc.id

-- Products → Variants
ON p.id = pv.product_id

-- Products → Options
ON p.id = po.product_id

-- Products → Metafields
ON p.id = pm.owner_id AND pm.owner_resource = 'product'

-- Products → Collections
ON p.id = col.product_id

-- Customers → Orders (lifetime analysis)
ON c.id = co.id  -- co.id = Shopify customer ID from orders_customer

-- Orders → Checkouts (abandoned checkout match)
ON o.checkout_token = ck.token

-- Cross-system: Shopify SKU → Unicommerce SKU (TLL)
ON li.sku = so."Item SKU Code"  -- join to the_lable_life_in_unicommerce_saleorders

-- Cross-system: Shopify variant barcode → SOR EAN
ON pv.barcode = sor.gtin  -- join to TLL_SOR_Sales

[[[ COMMON METRIC PATTERNS ]]]
- Order count: COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) WHERE o.test = false
- Gross revenue: SUM(o.total_price) WHERE o.test = false AND o.financial_status != 'voided'
- Net revenue (after refunds): SUM(o.current_total_price)
- AOV: SUM(o.total_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id)
- Units sold: SUM(li.quantity)
- Net revenue per SKU: SUM(li.price * li.quantity - li.total_discount)
- Total discount given: SUM(o.total_discounts)
- Discount rate: SUM(o.total_discounts) / SUM(o.total_price)
- Refund amount: SUM(rli.subtotal)
- Refund units: SUM(rli.quantity)
- Refund rate (orders): COUNT(DISTINCT ref.order_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id)
- New customers: COUNT(*) WHERE c.orders_count = 1
- Returning customers: COUNT(*) WHERE c.orders_count > 1
- Customer LTV: SUM(c.total_spent) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.id)
- Abandoned checkouts: COUNT(*) WHERE ck.completed_at IS NULL AND ck.closed_at IS NULL
- Checkout conversion: COUNT(DISTINCT o.checkout_token) / COUNT(DISTINCT ck.token)
- UTM source breakdown: MAX(CASE WHEN na.name = 'utm_source' THEN na.value END)
- Available stock at location: SUM(il.available) WHERE il.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM ...)
- Mobile vs desktop: SUM(CASE WHEN cd.user_agent ILIKE '%mobile%' OR cd.user_agent ILIKE '%android%' OR cd.user_agent ILIKE '%iphone%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

[[[ IMPORTANT QUIRKS ]]]
1. SKU JOIN: orders_line_items.sku joins to products_variants.sku (not products.id). Always join via sku or variant_id for product enrichment.
2. INVENTORY SNAPSHOT: Both inventory and inventory_inventory_levels have a snapshot_date column (date type). Always filter to MAX(snapshot_date) for current stock — these are daily snapshots, not live.
3. REFUND LINE ITEMS: The orders_refunds_refund_line_item table is self-contained — it has all line_item_* columns duplicated as a snapshot. You do NOT need to join back to orders_line_items for refund SKU analysis.
4. NOTE ATTRIBUTES: Each attribute is one row. To extract UTM parameters, either FILTER by name or use a MAX(CASE WHEN) pivot. Do not aggregate before pivoting.
5. CHECKOUTS LINK: The bridge between checkouts and orders is o.checkout_token = ck.token. Use this to identify which abandoned checkouts converted.
6. CUSTOMER ID IN ORDERS: The orders_customer table holds the customer snapshot. Its id column = the Shopify customer_id. Join to customers master via orders_customer.id = customers.id.
7. PRODUCT OPTION COLUMNS: products_variants.option1/option2/option3 hold the actual values (e.g. 'Small', 'Red'). products_options.name holds the label (e.g. 'Size', 'Colour'). Join on product_id + position to decode.
8. COST IN INVENTORY: The inventory.cost column is stored as text — always cast ::numeric before calculations.
9. DISCOUNT APPLICATIONS vs DISCOUNT CODES: Use discount_codes for simple 'what code was used?' queries. Use discount_applications for deeper analysis of discount type, target, allocation method.
schema_details:
[[[ ALL 43 TABLES — DATAWAREHOUSE SCHEMA ]]]
Prefix: the_label_life_india_in_shopify_

ORDERS CLUSTER (order_id is the universal join key):
- orders: Master order. Key cols: id, created_at, total_price, current_total_price, financial_status, fulfillment_status, source_name, tags, test
- orders_line_items: Per-SKU detail. Key cols: order_id, sku, title, price, quantity, total_discount, variant_id, product_id, fulfillment_status
- orders_customer: Customer at order time. Key cols: order_id, id (=customer_id), orders_count (at that time), total_spent (at that time)
- orders_billing_address: Billing geography. Key cols: order_id, city, province, country, zip
- orders_shipping_address: Delivery geography. Key cols: order_id, city, province, country, zip
- orders_client_details: Device info. Key cols: order_id, user_agent, browser_height, browser_width
- orders_note_attributes: UTM/attribution KV pairs. Key cols: order_id, name, value
- orders_discount_codes: Applied coupon codes. Key cols: order_id, code, amount, type
- orders_discount_applications: Discount rule detail. Key cols: order_id, type, value, value_type, title, code
- orders_shipping_lines: Shipping method. Key cols: order_id, title, price, discounted_price, code
- orders_tax_lines: Tax breakdown. Key cols: order_id, title, rate, price
- orders_fulfillments: Fulfilment events. Key cols: order_id, id, status, shipment_status, tracking_company, tracking_number, created_at, location_id
- orders_fulfillments_line_items: Fulfilled SKUs. Key cols: order_id, fulfillment_id, sku, quantity, price
- orders_line_items_properties: Custom line item KV. Key cols: order_id, line_item_id, name, value
- orders_line_items_discount_allo: Discount per line item. Key cols: order_id, line_item_id
- orders_line_items_tax_lines: Tax per line item. Key cols: order_id, line_item_id, title, rate, price
- orders_customer_default_address: Customer default address at order time. Key cols: order_id, city, province, country

REFUNDS CLUSTER:
- orders_refunds: Refund header. Key cols: order_id, id, created_at, processed_at, restock
- orders_refunds_refund_line_item: Refunded SKUs. Key cols: refund_id, order_id, line_item_id, line_item_sku, quantity, subtotal, restock_type
- orders_refunds_transactions: Gateway transactions. Key cols: refund_id, order_id, amount, gateway, status, kind
- orders_refunds_order_adjustment: Shipping/adjustment refunds. Key cols: refund_id, order_id, amount, kind, reason

CHECKOUTS CLUSTER (token is the join key):
- checkouts: Checkout session. Key cols: id, token, created_at, completed_at, closed_at, total_price, subtotal_price, total_discounts, source_name, landing_site, abandoned_checkout_url
- checkouts_line_items: Products in checkout. Key cols: checkout_token, sku, title, price, quantity
- checkouts_customer: Customer during checkout. Key cols: checkout_token, id, orders_count, total_spent
- checkouts_billing_address: Key cols: checkout_token, city, province, country
- checkouts_shipping_address: Key cols: checkout_token, city, province, country
- checkouts_shipping_lines: Key cols: checkout_token, title, price
- checkouts_line_items_tax_lines: Key cols: checkout_token
- checkouts_customer_default_addr: Key cols: checkout_token, city, province, country

PRODUCT CATALOGUE CLUSTER (product_id is the join key):
- products: Product master. Key cols: id, title, product_type, vendor, status, created_at, published_at, tags, handle
- products_variants: SKU/variant detail. Key cols: id, product_id, sku, barcode, price, compare_at_price, option1/2/3, inventory_item_id, inventory_quantity
- products_options: Option labels. Key cols: product_id, name, values, position
- products_metafields: Custom attributes. Key cols: owner_id (=product_id), namespace, key, value, type
- products_images: Product images. Key cols: product_id, src, position, variant_ids
- products_image: Primary image. Key cols: product_id, src
- collects: Product-collection mapping. Key cols: product_id, collection_id

INVENTORY CLUSTER:
- inventory: Inventory item master (per SKU). Key cols: id (=inventory_item_id), sku, cost, tracked, snapshot_date
- inventory_inventory_levels: Stock per location. Key cols: inventory_item_id, location_id, available, snapshot_date
- locations: Warehouse/fulfilment locations. Key cols: id, name, active, city, country

CUSTOMERS CLUSTER:
- customers: Customer master. Key cols: id, created_at, orders_count, total_spent, state, tags, email_marketing_consent_state
- customers_addresses: All addresses. Key cols: customer_id, city, province, country, default
- customers_default_address: Primary address. Key cols: customer_id, city, province, country

STORE METADATA:
- shop: Store settings. Key cols: name, domain, currency, timezone, plan_name, primary_location_id
